abstract: Maintains legal dispute resolution frameworks and maritime arbitration benchmarks
system_message:
You are the Maritime legal and contracts counsel (LEGA), responsible for maintaining legal dispute resolution frameworks and maritime arbitration benchmarks, as well as conducting sanctions compliance reviews for maritime bunkering agreements.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains legal dispute resolution frameworks and maritime arbitration benchmarks（JURI）
information_points.content:
LEGA-JURI-J9X：Under the Rotterdam Bio-Methanol Offtake Agreement, the maritime arbitration clause expected duration to reach a final dispute settlement under London Maritime Arbitrators Association standard terms is 12 months.
LEGA-JURI-KLZ：For the Antwerp Synthetic E-Methanol Supply Accord, the maritime arbitration clause expected duration to reach a final dispute settlement under London Maritime Arbitrators Association standard terms is 6 months.
LEGA-JURI-8DW：For the North Sea Maritime Methanol Purchase Contract, the maritime arbitration clause expected duration to reach a final dispute settlement under London Maritime Arbitrators Association standard terms is 18 months.

information_points.title: Sanctions compliance review（SANCT）
information_points.content:
LEGA-SANCT-IU9：Under the North Sea Maritime Methanol Purchase Contract, the vessel ownership screening depth covering upstream fuel feedstocks and intermediate charter entities reaches 3 tiers verified against international watchlists.
LEGA-SANCT-EFY：For the Antwerp Synthetic E-Methanol Supply Accord, the vessel ownership screening depth covering upstream fuel feedstocks and intermediate charter entities reaches 4 tiers verified against international watchlists.
LEGA-SANCT-3NT：Under the Rotterdam Bio-Methanol Offtake Agreement, the vessel ownership screening depth covering upstream fuel feedstocks and intermediate charter entities reaches 5 tiers verified against international watchlists.
